review_note: Supersedes v1 for current prepared-scope discovery; v1 remains historical. Reviewed merged M3-05/06 and M3-07/08 metadata, not a new live source capture. Contains all seven supported prepared identities plus earlier candidates, not a claim that any operator has downloaded them. No observation samples or inferred coverage. National KFE 2023 base is observation-derived review; regional bases remain unknown. No full-source catalog, semantic search, calculation permission or M13-09 holdout.

evidence.section: The demo's own series are genuinely ambiguous
The catalog is the semantic layer, already built
A third of the catalog is archived
Base-year variants make deflation a trap
The reference scenario needs a clarification, not a lookup
